errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по низходящ ред според размера, като най-големият (син) започва от 12 часа и се движи по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest (blue) starting at the 12 o'clock position. This is incorrect. The sectors are not sorted by size (e.g., the smallest slice, 9.1%, is next to the largest, 40.9%), and the blue slice is in the bottom-right quadrant, not at the top.
